payload.reason: The evidence provides multiple claims regarding the effectiveness of the NCEL approach, demonstrating its superior performance compared to baseline methods across various datasets and its efficiency in processing large-scale data.

claims.text: NCEL outperforms all baseline methods in both easy and hard datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness in collective entity linking.
NCEL consistently achieves better performance across five different datasets, indicating strong generalization ability.
The model's efficiency is enhanced by applying GCN on subgraphs, allowing it to handle large-scale data effectively.
